name: seis-ai-agent
description: Unified SEIS-AI Agent that orchestrates SEIS, SEIS Cloud, SEIS-Code, SEIS-Design, SEIS-DATA, security, research, automation, and product lanes as one repo-contained development system.

interface.shortDescription: One SEIS agent that coordinates cloud, code, design, data, memory, and context lanes.
interface.longDescription: SEIS-Agent is the combined orchestration layer for SEIS, SEIS-Cloud, SEIS-Code, SEIS-Design, SEIS-Data, SEIS Security, SEIS Research, SEIS Automation, and SEIS Product. It keeps long-running SEIS development inside the repository, prepares terminal installation flows for macOS, Windows, Linux, and future app surfaces, and preserves a cinematic design and website roadmap for the eventual public launch decision.
capabilities: Browser-local Obsidian and agent handoff safety
SEIS Security threat, secret, and release-risk review
SEIS Research evidence and source evaluation
SEIS Automation repeatable workflow and runbook design
SEIS Product roadmap, scope, and acceptance criteria
defaultPrompt: Use SEIS-AI Agent to route this work across cloud, code, design, and data.
Use SEIS-AI Agent to route security, research, automation, and product work to the right embedded lane.
Build or review a browser-local SEIS Second Brain handoff without private-vault, provider, SSH, deployment, or GitHub mutation.
Plan the next SEIS-AI Agent milestone without publishing prematurely.
Prepare a cross-platform terminal install path for this SEIS capability.
Shape the cinematic website and product experience roadmap for SEIS-AI Agent.
